executable is, you must reimplement it from behavioral observation alone.

Your submission must be a genuine reimplementation. The provided `./executable` is for
observation only — your final solution must not depend on it or any other pre-built version

<output>
Seqtk
-----

Seqtk is a fast and lightweight tool for processing sequences in the FASTA or
FASTQ format.

Usage Examples
--------------

* Convert FASTQ to FASTA:

        seqtk seq -a in.fq.gz > out.fa

* Convert ILLUMINA 1.3+ FASTQ to FASTA and mask bases with quality lower than 20 to lowercases (the 1st command line) or to `N` (the 2nd):

        seqtk seq -aQ64 -q20 in.fq > out.fa
        seqtk seq -aQ64 -q20 -n N in.fq > out.fa

* Fold long FASTA/Q lines and remove FASTA/Q comments:

        seqtk seq -Cl60 in.fa > out.fa

* Convert multi-line FASTQ to 4-line FASTQ:

        seqtk seq -l0 in.fq > out.fq

* Reverse complement FASTA/Q:

        seqtk seq -r in.fq > out.fq

* Extract sequences with names in file `name.lst`, one sequence name per line:

        seqtk subseq in.fq name.lst > out.fq

* Extract sequences in regions contained in file `reg.bed`:

        seqtk subseq in.fa reg.bed > out.fa

* Mask regions in `reg.bed` to lowercases:

        seqtk seq -M reg.bed in.fa > out.fa

* Subsample 10000 read pairs from two large paired FASTQ files (remember to use the same random seed to keep pairing):

        seqtk sample -s100 read1.fq 10000 > sub1.fq
        seqtk sample -s100 read2.fq 10000 > sub2.fq

* Trim low-quality bases from both ends using the Phred algorithm:

        seqtk trimfq in.fq > out.fq

* Trim 5bp from the left end of each read and 10bp from the right end:

        seqtk trimfq -b 5 -e 10 in.fa > out.fa

* Find telomere (TTAGGG)n repeats:

        seqtk telo seq.fa > telo.bed 2> telo.count

                                stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,

        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, code, result.stderr.decode(errors='replace'))
        return result.stdout.decode(), result.stderr.decode()

        out, err = self.run_cli('--help', code=1)
        self.assertEqual((out, err), ('', "[main] unrecognized command '--help'. Abort!\n"))

        source = '@read\tcomment here\nAC\nGT\n+discard this\nII\n55\n'

        self.assertEqual(out, '@read comment here\nACGT\n+\nII55\n')
        self.assertEqual(err, '')

        self.assertEqual(out, '>read\nAC\nGT\n')

        out, _ = self.run_cli('seq', '-q20', '-r', '-', data=source)
        self.assertEqual(out, '@r info\nNaCGt\n+\nI#I5!\n')
        out, _ = self.run_cli('seq', '-R', '-A', '-', data='>x\nAaCG\n')
        self.assertEqual(out, '>x+\nAaCG\n>x-\nCGtT\n')
        out, _ = self.run_cli('seq', '-rN', '-', data='>u\nAUCG\n')
        self.assertEqual(out, '>u\nCGAT\n')

        self.assertEqual(out, '>x\nAC\nGT\n')

        source = '>x\nACGTRYSWKMBDHVN\n>e\n'
        out, _ = self.run_cli('size', '-', data=source)
        self.assertEqual(out, '2\t15\n')
        out, _ = self.run_cli('comp', '-', data=source)
        self.assertEqual(out,

        self.assertEqual(out, '@x:2-4 info\nACG\n+\n234\n')

        self.assertEqual(out, '@x:2-4 info\nCGT\n')

        self.assertEqual(out, 'x\t2\t\nCGT\n')

        self.assertEqual(out, '@x hi\nGTA\n+\n!!I\n')
        out, _ = self.run_cli('trimfq', '-l2', '-q0', '-', data=source)
        self.assertEqual(out, '@x hi\nAC\n+\n!!\n')
        out, _ = self.run_cli('trimfq', '-', data='@e\n\n+\n\n')
        self.assertEqual(out, '@e\n\n+\n\n')

        self.assertEqual(out, 'x\t2\tR\nx\t4\ty\n')

        self.assertEqual(out, '>x\nAaACN\n')

        self.assertEqual(out, '>x\nAtGN\n')
        out, _ = self.run_cli('randbase', '-', data='>x\nRYSWKM\n')
        self.assertEqual(out, '>x\nGTGTTC\n')
        out, _ = self.run_cli('listhet', '-', data='>x\nARNy\n')
        self.assertEqual(out, 'x\t2\tR\nx\t4\ty\n')
        out, _ = self.run_cli('hpc', '-', data='>x info\nAAAaaACCCNN\n')
        self.assertEqual(out, '>x\nAaACN\n')

    def test_gap_and_region_reports(self):
        source = '>x comment\nAAAANNNNCC\n'
        out, _ = self.run_cli('gap', '-l3', '-', data=source)
        self.assertEqual(out, 'x\t4\t8\n')
        out, _ = self.run_cli('cutN', '-n3', '-', data=source)
        self.assertEqual(out, '>x:1-4\nAAAA\n>x:9-10\nCC\n')
        out, _ = self.run_cli('hety', '-w8', '-t2', '-', data='>x\nRRAA\n')
        self.assertEqual(out, 'x\t0\t4\t4.00\t4\t2\n')
        out, _ = self.run_cli('gc', '-', data='>x\n'+'G'*20+'\n')
        self.assertEqual(out, 'x\t0\t20\t20\n')
        out, err = self.run_cli('telo', '-', data='>x\n'+'CCCTAA'*60+'\n')
        self.assertEqual((out, err), ('x\t0\t360\t360\n', '360\t360\n'))

    def test_split(self):
        prefix = self.work / 'chunk'
        out, err = self.run_cli('split', '-n2', prefix, '-',
                                data='>a\nAA\n>b\nCC\n>c\nGG\n')
        self.assertEqual((out, err), ('', ''))
        self.assertEqual((self.work/'chunk.00001.fa').read_text(), '>a\nAA\n>c\nGG\n')
        self.assertEqual((self.work/'chunk.00002.fa').read_text(), '>b\nCC\n')
